newsitem.title: CHINA: S&P raises Polysindo ratings to BB-plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Polysindo ratings to BB-plus.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday that it had raised the ratings of both PT Polysindo Eka Perkas and Polysindo International Finance Co BV to BB-plus from BB.

At the same time, S&P said it has assigned its BB-plus rating to Polysindo International Finance Co BV's US$200 million guaranteed secured notes due 2007. The notes will be unconditionally secured by Polysindo.

In addition, the ratings on Polysindo International Finance Co BV's US$260 million guaranteed secured notes due 2006 has been revised to BB-plus from BB. The ratings of Polysindo's US$125 million senior notes due 2001 also have been raised to BB-plus from BB.
The outlooks for both isues have been revised to stable from positive.
S&P said it has withdrawn its rating for Polysindo's senior unsecured US$125 million notes due 2001.
Polysindo's ratings upgrade reflects the completion of the first stage of a major upgrade to the company's petrochemical production capability, S&P said.

It said Polysindo's stable outlook anticipates the successful commissioning of the second stage of the petrochemical facility by late 1997 and an improvement in the company's protection ratios from their 1996 levels.
